rationale: I accept this exact v19 extension catalog and bound native audit. My own initial quality review is bound to the exact candidate, and all 49 accepted additions are present exactly once on the expected 27 boards with unchanged pair, result, candidate digest and two-edge provenance. There are no diagnostics, competing outputs, new concepts, new seeds or new targets. The archived candidate covers exactly all 68 currently selectable Alchimie cores; I matched every source record to the live pack and independently replayed their preserved routes and minimum plans. For each affected board the proposed core, seeds, target, recipes, routes and par match that accepted source core, and an independent bounded breadth-first plan search on core plus additions preserves the original optimal par. Every new pair is absent from its core, remains within the existing concept scope and correct seed/target cohort, and uses two current non-distractor graph edges of strength at least 0.7. All scopes remain within the native concept, recipe and route bounds. Proposal node and edge snapshots match the current KG; differences from archival node snapshots are confined to current aliases and degrees. The current native audit covers all 27 affected boards and 49 additions and confirms unchanged cores/routes/par plus preserved graph provenance. I verified all nine live source bindings and 156 runtime file hashes, including current rankings, pack, KG, rubric, the installed reviewed quick/world catalogs and unchanged authored-v19 source. Archival runtime/rankings references in the initial candidate remain historical inheritance; the live audit supplies the current bindings. No material quality concern remains.
